name: chronicle-marketplace
description: Claude Code plugins by Kristian Andersen — Chronicle (persistent memory) and SDLC Workflow (ticket-driven git).

plugins.name: chronicle
plugins.description: Per-project persistent memory for any Claude agent (vault search, lessons, reminders, decisions).

plugins.name: sdlc-workflow
plugins.description: Ticket-driven git workflow: resolve a Jira ticket (existing, new, or from a Slack thread), open a compliant branch, and enforce [TICKET-ID] commits and <type>/TICKET-ID-desc branches with git hooks.
